title: 70 - Conversation
summary: [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]] looks healthier but questions whether a replica would still be her. Her daughters were horrified and [[character:howard-brodeur|Howie]] unsure, and she declines for now. After consulting [[character:ms-benning|Benning]], [[character:howard]] explains that Bridget could record a codicil and replace it later and plans to build the equipment anyway, using stasis for preservation. With [[character:bob-replicant|Bob-1]] improving the android design so fast that Bill is embarrassed, Howard expects [[technology:manny|Manny]] to resemble [[character:robert-johansson|the original Bob]] and be able to eat, so Bridget suggests dinner. Howard sees a wartime use for replication in [[character:george-butterworth|Butterworth]]'s military experience. [[character:bill]] advises raising the idea first at a moot, now held weekly because of the [[species:others|Others]]. Howard later explains that the scan would be fatal to a living subject. Butterworth agrees in principle to eventual replication, and Howard tells him to revise his will.

updates.current_state: He plans to build replication equipment despite Bridget's decision to wait and has approached Butterworth as a potential wartime recruit. He looks forward to visiting Bridget through the upgraded Manny.
She still sounds tired but is taking better care of herself. She puts off replication and suggests having dinner with Howard once Manny can eat.
He is rapidly improving the android design used for Manny.
He is open to recruiting Butterworth through replication and wants the Bobs to discuss it at a moot before Howard makes the offer.
He gives Howard verbal assent to eventual replication and is told he will need to revise his will.
